title: Finite quotient detection by sufficiently deep local reductions
statement: Let $R$ be a Noetherian commutative ring [def-weil-pbc-noetherian-ring], $S$ a commutative $R$-algebra finite as an $R$-module [def-weil-finitely-generated-module], and $\mathfrak p$ a prime ideal. Put $A=R_{\mathfrak p}$ [def-weil-pbc-localization-at-prime], $\mathfrak m$ its maximal ideal and $Q=\{\mathfrak q\subset S:\mathfrak q\text{ prime},\ \mathfrak q\cap R=\mathfrak p\}$. For $q\in Q$ put $N_q$ equal to the maximal ideal of $S_q$ and let $\varphi_q:A\to S_q$ be the canonical localized homomorphism. For each $n\geq0$ there is $k\geq n$ such that, for every index set $\iota$, finite subset $t\subset\iota$, and families $r_i\in A$ and $s_i\in S$, the equalities $\sum_{i\in t}\varphi_q(r_i)(s_i/1)=0$ in $S_q/N_q^k$ for every $q\in Q$ imply $\sum_{i\in t}(r_i\bmod\mathfrak m^n)\otimes s_i=0$ in $(A/\mathfrak m^n)\otimes_R S$ [def-weil-module-base-change]. The integer $k$ is independent of the families and their index set.

proof.text: If n=0 choose k=0. Each coefficient in A/m^0 is zero, so each pure tensor and the finite sum are zero.
For n>0, obtain one c>=1 with N_q^c contained in mS_q for every q. Set k=n*c, so n<=k. Raising the containment to the nth power gives N_q^k contained in (m^n)S_q; ideal mapping commutes with powers.

The quotient vanishing says the local finite sum lies in N_q^k, using that the quotient homomorphism preserves sums. The containment puts it in (m^n)S_q for every q. Apply base-ideal detection to conclude that the tensor finite sum is zero.

theorem local_tensor_quotient_detection
    (R : Type u) (S : Type v) [CommRing R] [CommRing S] [Algebra R S]
    [IsNoetherianRing R] [Module.Finite R S] (p : Ideal R) [p.IsPrime] (n : ℕ) :
    let A := Localization.AtPrime p
    let m := IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal A
    let Q := p.primesOver S
    ∃ k : ℕ, n ≤ k ∧ ∀ (ι : Type w) (t : Finset ι) (r : ι → A) (s : ι → S),
      (∀ q : Q,
        ∑ i ∈ t, Ideal.Quotient.mk
          ((IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal (Localization.AtPrime q.1)) ^ k)
          (Localization.localRingHom p q.1 (algebraMap R S)
            (Ideal.LiesOver.over (P := q.1) (p := p)) (r i) *
            algebraMap S (Localization.AtPrime q.1) (s i)) = 0) →
      (∑ i ∈ t, (Ideal.Quotient.mk (m ^ n) (r i)) ⊗ₜ[R] s i) = 0
